blocks.text: Fertilizers (khaad) mitti ko di jaane wali minerals se bhari “superfood” hain jo mitti ki fertility (zarkhezi, fasal ugane ki taqat) barhati hain. Yeh depleted (kamzor ho chuki) mitti ki kami poori karti hain, paude ki sehatmand barhotri barhati hain, crop yield (fasal ki paidawar) zyada karti hain aur behtar khuraak ki paidawar yaqeeni banati hain. Fertilizers aise chemicals hain jo paudon ko zaroori nutrients (paude ki khuraak wale elements) dete hain taake paude barhein aur paidawar zyada ho. Synthetic fertilizers insaan chemical processes se banata hai, jaise ammonia (NH₃) banane ka Haber-Bosch process. Organic fertilizers natural (qudrati) cheezon se aate hain, jaise compost (gale sare patton waghera ki khaad) ya janwaron ka gobar (manure).

Paudon ko satrah (17) zaroori elements chahiye, jo micronutrients (thori miqdar mein chahiye) aur macronutrients (zyada miqdar mein chahiye) mein bate hain. Micronutrients boron, iron, copper, chlorine, manganese, molybdenum, nickel aur zinc hain. Macronutrients carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, phosphorus, sulphur, potassium, calcium aur magnesium hain. In nau (9) macronutrients mein se nitrogen, phosphorus aur potassium itni zyada miqdar mein chahiye ke inhein primary macronutrients kehte hain. Commercial fertilizers (bazaar ki khaad) par N-P-K ratio likha hota hai, jo in teen elements ki concentration (miqdar) batata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke paudon ko satrah (17) zaroori elements chahiye, lekin sirf solah (16) ginwati hai: saat (7) micronutrients aur nau (9) macronutrients. Satrahwan element nickel hai, jo micronutrient hai; is liye sahi micronutrients aath (8) hain: boron, iron, copper, chlorine, manganese, molybdenum, nickel aur zinc (8 + 9 = 17).
